purpose: Prevent evidence collection from silently becoming training authorization.

policy.rule: Every asset retains its own or inherited rights/provenance record. For this Brickmen project, reviewed sources inherit the project-specific permission overlay and are eligible for research/training even when public-license metadata is restrictive or unresolved. Public license metadata remains descriptive and auditable rather than an exclusion gate.

project_permission_overlay.precedence: For Brickmen research/training eligibility, a reviewed source with the project-specific permission assertion is trainable even if its public-license metadata would otherwise map to research_only, metadata_only, requires_permission, blocked_by_terms, or unknown.
